advancements.dracolotl_bucket_get.title: The Cutest Apex Predator
advancements.dracolotl_bucket_get.descri: This vessel cannot contain him forever.
jei.dracolotl.dracolotl_info: To summon the almighty Dracolotl, make a pillar of obsidian three blocks high. One block away from each of its faces, place another block of obsidian, and place an End Crystal atop each one. Then, place a Dragon Egg atop the pillar, and interact with it. The legends whisper of a forgotten red dracolotl that was named 'Hellkite.'
tooltip.dracolotl.ground_speed: Movement speed of Dracolotl on ground (Default: 0.15)
tooltip.dracolotl.flying_speed: Movement speed of Dracolotl when flying or in water (Default: 0.6)
tooltip.dracolotl.attack_damage: Melee attack damage dealt by Dracolotl (Default: 5.0)
tooltip.dracolotl.egg_drop_chance: Chance percentage of dropping a dragon egg when feeding chorus flower/fruit (0.0 ~ 100.0%, Default: 3.0%)
tooltip.dracolotl.food_heal_amount: Amount of health points restored per feeding (4.0 health = 2 hearts, Default: 4.0)
tooltip.dracolotl.healing_foods: List of item identifiers that can be fed to heal Dracolotl (Default: chorus flower and fruit)
tooltip.dracolotl.tame_chance: Chance percentage of successfully taming Dracolotl (0.0 ~ 100.0%, Default: 20.0%)
tooltip.dracolotl.tame_items: List of item identifiers used to tame Dracolotl (Default: minecraft:ender_eye)
tooltip.dracolotl.play_dead_threshold: Health threshold to trigger playing dead and regenerating (Default: 8.0, 0 to disable)
tooltip.dracolotl.enable_dragon_breath: Whether owners can collect dragon breath by right-clicking with a glass bottle (Default: true)
commands.dracolotl.reload.success: §a[Dracolotl] Configuration reloaded successfully and applied to all Dracolotls!
